title: release(ui-merge): one release lane for both scopes — @object-ui joins the fixed group, @objectstack/console builds from ui/apps/console, the objectui pin is deleted (#25711)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKAHLK79xmvJyPStopRpPQ2)_

Part of objectstack#25677
Fixes #25711
Blocked-by: sub-issue 5 of #25677 (the subtree PR that adds `ui/`; not filed yet)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

> ⛔ **Draft, Tier H, cutover window only.** Verified on the merged tree at objectui@cd70b7818 (objectstack `main` 43edf90b56 + PR A #25710 + `git subtree add --prefix=ui` of objectui `main` + the verification branch's adaptations + this diff). Red on `main` by design until the subtree PR of sub-issue 5: without `ui/`, `check-changeset-fixed` reports the 39 `@object-ui/*` names in `fixed` as stale, and `pnpm console:build` has no `@object-ui/console` to build.

## What changes

**1. One fixed group** (`.changeset/config.json`). The 39 public `@object-ui/*` packages join the `@objectstack/*` fixed group; `@object-ui/example-*`, `@object-ui/site` and `@object-ui/test-support` are ignored. `ui/.changeset/config.json` is deleted by the ui-side patch (changesets reads one config per repository), and objectui's pending `ui/.changeset/*.md` move to the root `.changeset/`. `check-changeset-no-major` now reads `packages/console/build-dist.sh` as the Console's packed-copy build script, and `check-empty-changeset`'s frontmatter-parser family loses the deleted objectui digest.

**2. `@objectstack/console` builds in this workspace.** `packages/console/build-dist.sh` copies `ui/apps/console/dist` (built by turbo through `@object-ui/console#build`) into `packages/console/dist`, ships the tracked `sdui.manifest.json` (ADR-0080), and runs the single-zod canary over the bytes it ships. Root task `@objectstack/console#build:dist` (`turbo.json`) depends on `@object-ui/console#build`; `pnpm console:build` runs it, and `pnpm release` / `cut-rc.yml` run it after `pnpm run build`. `files` and `prepublishOnly` are unchanged. `scripts/build-console.sh` is deleted. The CLI's remedy for a missing Console dist names `pnpm console:build`.

**3. The objectstack-side pin is deleted.** `.objectui-sha`, `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` (+ selftest), `scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs`, `scripts/objectui-range.mjs`, `scripts/check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs`, `scripts/check-console-sha.mjs`, `scripts/check-console-injection.mjs`, `scripts/assert-console-spec-injection.mjs`, `scripts/console-spec-probes.mjs`, `packages/spec/scripts/build-console-objectstack-root.test.ts`; the pin reads in `cut-rc.yml` ("THE objectui PIN IS AN INPUT HERE" and `Read the committed objectui pin`), `release.yml`, `lint.yml`, `showcase-smoke.yml` and the root `package.json` scripts (`objectui:*`, `check:console-sha`, `check:console-injection`, `check:objectui-*`, `check:prerelease-pins`; `pnpm dev*` no longer runs `check:console-sha`). `scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs` stays. Release notes (`collect-release-notes.sh`) say "no objectui pin" when the new ref has none. Gate self-tests and rosters that named the deleted scripts follow (`dispatch-gates`, `pnpm-filter-targets`, `check-pnpm-filter-targets` (tree-aware: foreign `@object-ui/` targets must be 0 without `ui/`, >0 with it), `bare-root-worklist`, `check-type-check-coverage`). The lockstep count in `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx` and `scripts/publish-smoke-pack.mjs` reads 112, both scopes (`check:lockstep-package-count --fix`), and `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json` drops the deleted test.

**4. The objectui-side pin is deleted, as a patch.** `ui/` does not exist on `main`, so this half is `scripts/ui-import/4a-ui-side.patch` with its apply and verify commands in `scripts/ui-import/README.md`, applied by sub-issue 5's adaptation commit. It deletes `.objectstack-sha`, `.objectstack-pin/`, `bump-objectstack.sh`, `objectstack-pin.mjs`, `objectstack-floor.mjs`, `check-spec-range-floors.mjs`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs`, the dist-pin Vite probes `vite-objectstack-spec-dist.ts` / `vite-objectstack-client-dist.ts`, `changeset-release.yml`, `spec-range-floors.yml`, `release-github-releases.mjs` and their tests. The single-zod guard moves to `ui/scripts/vite-single-zod.ts` (it runs in every console build); `apps/console/vite.config.ts` drops both injections. Every reader of the Changesets config goes through a new `changesetConfigPath()` (own root standalone, monorepo root when nested).

**5. One release lane.** objectui's `changeset-release.yml` is gone; root `release.yml` publishes both scopes in one `pnpm -r publish`, and the root `scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` cuts one GitHub Release per package tag across both scopes.

## The four deleted Console checks, and what proves the same thing now

| Deleted | What it proved | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `assert-console-spec-injection.mjs` | the built Console bundles THIS tree's `@objectstack/spec`, not the copy objectui's lockfile installed | Can no longer be false. Every `@objectstack/*` dependency under `ui/` is `workspace:^` (33 spec, 2 client, 2 lint, 2 formula rows measured), which pnpm links and never resolves from the registry; the merged lockfile has 0 registry entries for `@objectstack/spec` or `@objectstack/client` and 37 `link:` rows to `packages/spec`. The single-zod guard (Vite, `ui/scripts/vite-single-zod.ts`) and canary (`build-dist.sh`, on the shipped bytes) still run in every build. |
| `check-console-injection.mjs` | a Console dist restored from the pin-keyed cache was built against the current spec | Can no longer be false. The cache keyed on `.objectui-sha` is gone; turbo's hash for `@object-ui/console#build` includes `@objectstack/spec#build`, `@objectstack/client#build` and `@objectstack/lint#build` (measured with `turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console --dry=json`), so a spec change misses the cache. |
| `check-console-sha.mjs` | the local `packages/console/dist` was built from the pinned objectui commit | The pin it compared against is gone, so that drift cannot occur. A local dist can still be older than `ui/` after a pull; `pnpm console:build` rebuilds it (a turbo cache hit when nothing changed). Nothing checks this on `pnpm dev` any more: reported to the dispatcher. |
| `console-spec-probes.mjs` | the shared probe derivation for the two injection checks above | Left with them; nothing else imported it. |

## Verification (merged tree, objectui@cd70b7818)

- `pnpm changeset version`: all 112 public packages (73 `@objectstack/*`, 39 `@object-ui/*`) move 18.1.0 → 18.2.0 in one bump. The 8 private `@objectstack/*` packages move as they do on `main`. The private VS Code extension `object-ui` moves alone (18.1.0 → 18.1.1), because the root `check-changeset-fixed` and the release scripts hold the fixed group to public packages; the ui patch makes objectui's `check-changeset-fixed` accept a private package outside `fixed` when `privatePackages.version` is true.
- `pnpm -r publish --dry-run` after the version: 112 packages, 39 `@object-ui/*` + 72 `@objectstack/*` + `create-objectstack`, all 18.2.0. `pnpm pack` of `@object-ui/core`: `@objectstack/spec` `workspace:^` → `^18.2.0`, `@object-ui/types` `workspace:*` → `18.2.0`.
- `pnpm console:build` (CI=true): exit 0, single-zod canary green. The packed `@objectstack/console` has the same top-level `dist/` entries as the published 18.1.0 tarball, minus `dist/.objectstack-injection.json` and `dist/.objectui-sha`; assets 2,268 → 2,381 (newer objectui), tarball 9,260K → 9,140K.
- Console eager-closure budget (`ui/scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs`, ceiling 3,496.0 KB): this build 3,054.2 KB gzipped, `vendor-objectstack` 1,605.2 KB; the published 18.1.0 dist measured by the same ceilings: 3,522.3 KB, `vendor-objectstack` 1,851.5 KB. The membership half is red identically on both (`packages/core`: 1 of 89 modules in `vendor-objectstack`), so it predates this PR.
- The ui-side patch: steps 1–3 of its README reproduce the edited `ui/` tree byte for byte (56 files); `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:vitest-config`, `lint:root` exit 0; `vitest run scripts/__tests__` 31 failed / 5,488 passed, where 17 fail identically without the patch and 14 read objectui's nested `ui/.github/`, which 4b deletes.
- actionlint 1.7.7 over `release.yml`, `cut-rc.yml`, `lint.yml`, `showcase-smoke.yml`: exit 0. No step reads a pin file.

## Gates (this branch, no `ui/`)

`dispatch-gates --commands` derives 166 families for this diff; all 166 ran, and `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles: 164 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED. The run was taken on the branch at `ea18e50bb3`; after merging `main` (`0189524a41`), the 17 families that read the files the merge brought in were run again, with the same results. 157 exit 0, including `check:required-contexts`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:lockstep-package-count` (112) and `check:nul-bytes`. The other 9 are red or not measured because `ui/`, PR B or 4b has not landed yet, as designed:

| Gate | Exit | Why red here | Clears when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `check-changeset-fixed` | 1 | the 39 `@object-ui/*` names in `fixed` have no package without `ui/` (on the merged tree: exit 0, 112 packages) | sub-issue 5 |
| `check-prerelease-pin-watch --self-test`, `--verbose` | 1, 1 | named only by `prerelease-pin-watch.yml`; this PR deletes the script | PR B of #25697 |
| `check-self-test-wired --self-test` | 1 | `ci.yml` `console-pin` and `prerelease-pin-watch.yml` still invoke deleted scripts | PR B of #25697 |
| `check:pm-dispatch-gates` | 1 | 3 of 1,913 fast-tier cases, all on the same live invocations of deleted scripts | PR B of #25697 |
| `check:console-sha`, `check:console-injection` | NOT-MEASURED (254) | root scripts deleted here; only the `console-pin` job names them | PR B of #25697 |
| `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:sdui-lockstep` | 1, 1 | they read `.objectui-sha` | 4b PR 2 (#25712) |

## Depends on, outside this PR

- **Sub-issue 5** (subtree PR): adds `ui/`; this PR merges right after it.
- **PR B of #25697** (retire the pin gates in the cutover window): removes the `console-pin` job and `console` filter in `ci.yml`, `prerelease-pin-watch.yml`, and the live specimens in the `dispatch-gates` self-test that still name `check-prerelease-pin-watch.mjs`. Until it lands, `prerelease-pin-watch.yml` runs a script this PR deletes.
- **4b PR 2 (#25712)**: `check-sdui-lockstep`, `check-sdui-manifest` and `gen-sdui-manifest-node` read `.objectui-sha` and go red without it; regenerating `sdui.manifest.json` from `ui/` is theirs (the root copy lags the old pin, and `build-dist.sh` ships the tracked one). Also the nested `ui/.github/` and the tests that read it, and both AGENTS.md files.
- **Maintainer**: the npm token used by `release.yml` must have publish rights on the `@object-ui` scope (card risk 1). Not checked here.
